context_for_next_testing_agent: Weight-based invoice calculation fix fully tested. Key formula: Line Total = Qty × (packs_per_case × weight_per_pack × lb_factor) × unit_price. For LB, lb_factor=1.0. For OZ, lb_factor=0.0625. Non-weight items (GAL, EA, CT, etc.) use simple Qty × Price. Test file: /app/backend/tests/test_weight_based_calculations.py. WM-001 invoice has 3 items demonstrating weight-based (SALMON, SHRIMP) and non-weight (OLIVE OIL) calculations.
